strega-reconciliation-monitor.reason: FW-T1 fix wave: gate state derivation on 'uplink && uplink.recorded_at' so a never-uplinked valve's LEFT JOIN NULL row is not mistaken for a real observation (phantom OBSERVED_COMPLETE/OBSERVED_RUNNING) (+22); FW-T1b Gap A: query also selects d.updated_at AS state_updated_at, and the state-derivation block additionally gates on Date.parse(state_updated_at) >= Date.parse(commanded_at) (both Number.isFinite, epoch-millis compare) so a stale current_state paired with a fresh Class-A uplink is not mistaken for a real observation (+381); FW-T1c: RECONCILIATION_GRACE_SEC widened 300 -> 1800 (a full Class-A 600s uplink cycle plus margin on both the OPEN-delivery and CLOSE-confirmation legs) so a genuine run confirming 600-1500s after expected_close_at no longer times out to the litres-excluded STALE_NO_OBSERVATION (+1). FW-T1c R1 (review be3346a8): the late-promotion path (STALE_NO_OBSERVATION rescan + 6h window guard, +391) was reverted per review ruling - it re-opened unbounded phantom-litres exposure (MAJOR-1, any later valve activity within 6h revived a stale row regardless of which run it belonged to) and collided with osi-valve-control's runObserveTick dedupe model (MAJOR-2, race-dependent duplicate rows). The node is now byte-for-byte the a88b88dd (FW-T1b) version plus only the grace constant change; delta shrunk from 794 to 404, exact vs origin/main. Valve control Phase B Task 6 (+3809): the active-expectations SELECT LEFT JOINs devices for user_id/irrigation_zone_id (canLog guard, mirrors workers.js's runOnceTick); the OBSERVED_COMPLETE transition for trigger IN (on_valve_schedule, unexplained) now INSERTs an irrigation_events row (observed-span duration, event_uuid omitted so the sync trigger mints it, reason distinct from one_time_open) in the SAME transaction as the state UPDATE, so a crash cannot leave a completed actuation with no event or vice versa; ONCE runs are excluded (already logged at fire time by workers.js, avoiding a double count); the pre-existing empty catch on the close() call was also converted to a visible node.warn (touched-node silent-catch ratchet). cloud full-parity Task P3-E1 (+671, exact vs origin/main): loads osiLib once per tick and, inside the same per-expectation transaction as the state UPDATE, best-effort emits a VALVE_RUNTIME_CHANGED sync event via osi-valve-control's new emitRuntimeChanged() -- this is the code seam for the reconciliation-transition half of the ValveRuntime derived-state resource (the other half is the write-strega-expectation node, for new active_actuation rows). cloud full-parity Task P4-E1 (+650, exact vs origin/main): beside that same emitRuntimeChanged call, best-effort emits VALVE_ACTUATION_ARCHIVED via osi-valve-control's new emitActuationArchived() -- unconditional (it no-ops on its own for the non-terminal OBSERVED_RUNNING transition), so this is the terminal-transition half of the ValveActuation archive resource (the other half is cancel.js, for the CANCELLED transition). [re-measured on port/sdi12-edge: origin/main 2876 -> HEAD 8404 = +5528, all of it the pre-existing feat/valve-control baseline; this port did not touch the node]
